probe.capture_text:
BEGIN
INTERNAL CD
DEFAULT RC=0 RESULT2=0
NORES RC=5 RESULT2=205
INTERNAL CD
RES RC=0 RESULT2=0
INTERNAL CD
ALL RC=5 RESULT2=205
NORES-RES RC=5 RESULT2=0
NORES-ALL RC=5 RESULT2=205

observations: Default and RES emit INTERNAL CD and leave RC=0, Result2=0.
NORES emits no captured line and leaves RC=5, Result2=205; ALL emits INTERNAL CD and leaves RC=5, Result2=205.
NORES RES emits no captured line and leaves RC=5, Result2=0; NORES ALL emits no captured line and leaves RC=5, Result2=205.
limits: The startup sequence and output target are authored probe content on a disposable ADF copy.
The subsequent RES ALL call did not reach its marker during this run; this capture makes no claim about it or NORES RES ALL.
Neither the original ADF nor its C/Which bytes are copied into this repository.
